common.disclaimer: Results are estimates based on your answers and our data. They are not a replacement for a professional inspection by a mechanic.

landing.metaDescription: Tell us what's wrong with your car and get likely causes, safety advice and repair cost estimates. Delhi NCR.
landing.title: Know what's wrong with your car
landing.intro: Pick your car, tell us the problem and answer a few quick questions. You get the likely causes, safety advice and an estimated repair cost for your car.
landing.heroAlt: An orange car with a check mark showing it has been diagnosed
landing.step1Text: Search for your car or choose the make, model and year.
landing.step2Text: Choose a problem and answer one quick question at a time.
landing.step3Text: See the likely causes, what is safe to do, and the estimated cost for your car.
landing.helpNowText: Stuck on the road? Get safety steps and ask for a mechanic.

diagnose.whichCarText: We use it to check parts and estimate costs for your car.
diagnose.priceRangeUnsure: Price range: not sure (we'll show general guidance)
diagnose.carsFound: {count, plural, one {# car found} other {# cars found}}
diagnose.noMatch: No cars match “{query}”. Try just the model name, or pick the make below. If your car is not in our list, choose “My car isn't listed”.
diagnose.closestYear: We don't have that exact year, so these are the closest matches.
diagnose.unlistedText: We'll still help. Your answers help us add more cars.
diagnose.pricePaid: Roughly what did the car cost new?
diagnose.errMake: Type the make, for example Maruti Suzuki.
diagnose.errModel: Type the model, for example Gypsy.
diagnose.errYear: Type the year as 4 digits, between {min} and {max}.
diagnose.errFuel: Pick a fuel, or Not sure.
diagnose.errGearbox: Pick a gearbox, or Not sure.
diagnose.errSegment: Pick a price range, or Not sure.
diagnose.emergencyText: A few quick questions, then safety steps and a mechanic.
diagnose.describeHint: In your own words, English, Hindi or Hinglish. For example: “gaadi garam ho rahi hai”.
diagnose.describeError: Tell us a little about the problem, for example: AC is not cooling.
diagnose.checkUp: Nothing wrong, just want a check-up?
diagnose.earlierAnswer: Your earlier answer is highlighted. Pick it again or choose another.
diagnose.replyLabel: Or type your answer in your own words
diagnose.replyHint: English, Hindi or Hinglish. For example: “hawa 2 din mein kam ho jaati hai”.
diagnose.replyError: Type a few words first, or tap one of the answers above.
diagnose.addedToDescription: We added this to your description

photo.title: Add a photo
photo.intro: A photo of the problem (a leak, a warning light, the tyre) helps the mechanic. You can skip this.
photo.noPreview: {name}: preview not available on this device. We will convert it when you upload.
photo.modeWarning: A warning light on the dashboard
photo.added: Photo added. The mechanic will see it with your diagnosis.
photo.rules: JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 10 MB. We remove location and camera details before saving. Only you and our team can see your photos.
photo.badType: This file is not a photo we can use. Please send a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
photo.tooBig: This photo is too big. Please use one under 10 MB.
photo.empty: This file is empty. Please take or choose another photo.

result.notFinished: This diagnosis isn't finished yet, so this is the ranking so far.
result.title: Your result
result.couldNotNarrow: We couldn't narrow this down from your answers. A mechanic can inspect the car and find the cause.
result.verifyingPrices: Prices are being verified with our mechanics.

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.part_fit_verifiedExplain: The parts and prices were checked for your exact model.
coverage.segment_estimateExplain: Costs are typical for cars in your price range, not checked for your exact model.
coverage.general_guidanceExplain: General advice only: we don't know enough about your car to estimate costs.

estimate.title: Estimated cost
estimate.notEnoughData: We don't have enough price data for this repair yet. A mechanic will check the car and give you a price.
estimate.finalPrice: The final price depends on the mechanic's inspection.
estimate.noSegment: We can't estimate the cost without your car's price range. A mechanic will quote after checking.

feedback.title: Was this helpful?
feedback.comment: Anything to add? (optional, no personal details)

car3d.approximate: A generic car: the part's place on your car may differ.
